review_text: The app is easy to use and checkout was very fast.
My order arrived three days late and support never replied.
The product quality is excellent, but the price is too high.
I cannot reset my password. The error message is confusing.
Please add Apple Pay and more payment options.
The agent solved my problem quickly and was very helpful.
The dashboard is slow to load and sometimes crashes.
Great value and a smooth onboarding experience.
Tracking updates are missing, so I do not know where my package is.
The new reporting feature is useful, but exports need better formatting.
I was charged twice for one order. Please refund the duplicate charge.
The support team was friendly, although the wait time was long.
